headline: National Bank of Rwanda Raises Policy Rate to 17-Year High
summary: Rwanda's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate to 9.5 percent, reaching its highest level since 2009 to tame inflation.

impacts.name: Rwanda
impacts.why: Raising the benchmark policy rate increases domestic borrowing costs to curb inflationary pressures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent inflationary pressures compelled the central bank to tighten monetary policy by raising rates to a 17-year high.
